case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1124 OF 2022 (ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 2481 OF 2022)
court_name: IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
summary: Appellant convicted under Section 302 IPC for murdering brother Dashrath Nirmalkar. Key evidence included appellant's police confession (partially admissible under Sections 27/8 Evidence Act), bloodstained pick-axe discovered through disclosure, and testimonies from family witnesses. Courts rejected third-party involvement defense. Murder conviction reduced to culpable homicide under Exception 1 to Section 300 IPC due to alcohol-fueled quarrel constituting grave and sudden provocation.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
Section 25 of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872
Section 313 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
K.M. Nanavati v. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: Conviction under Section 302 IPC set aside; reduced to culpable homicide not amounting to murder under Exception 1 to Section 300 IPC; life sentence commuted to period already served.
